mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) compresses risk-free rates, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
